Cache

Use ETag and Last-Modified, Not Only max-age, on a Clincoo Site

A long max-age keeps stale HTML. ETag and Last-Modified let the CDN ask for a version without a full download.

This article is available in: Indonesia · English

After a deploy from editor.clincoo.buzz, visitors still see yesterday's home page. The cause is often an aggressive Cache-Control header on HTML documents.

Set HTML to must-revalidate or a short max-age. Let CSS and fonts use hashed filenames plus immutable.

ETag or Last-Modified enables conditional requests. If the file did not change, the server answers 304 and saves bandwidth.

Do not ask the AI to add a site-wide service worker precache just to feel fast. Validate HTTP cache first in the DevTools Network tab.

Clincoo on app.clincoo.buzz ships static files. The right headers make a new release visible without a hard refresh on every device.
